scope: Complete original degree-5 odd-polynomial QSVT Notebook: retain seed1 coefficients,500point normalization,phase finding,ten logical outputs,odd-degree projection,16measured/target values and original comparison plot. Fit six native projector angles with existing native Nelder-Mead using bounded seeded starts,not precomputed frozen phases. New phases checked against independent Circuit fullstate including absolutephase and clean work;projected polynomial checked separately. Phase branch need not equal frozen Classiq phase array,so no cross-branch complementary fullstate equivalence claim. Native angle equals twice scalar QSP phase. Existing qfunc composition and public named probabilities reused;no production API or dependency added. Numerical fit validation on4097points is not an analytic uniform-error certificate or generic QSP solver.
